what-I-build.eyebrow: Micro-label above services heading (e.g., 'What I build'). Max 3 words.
what-I-build.h2: Section title introducing services in {{CITY}} (e.g., 'Machine learning services in {{CITY}}'). Must include {{CITY}}.
what-I-build.lede: Introductory lede paragraph explaining direct delivery without account managers. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

svc-card.svc-num: Two-digit item index starting from '01' to '06'.
svc-card.h3: Specific service title tailored to the target role (e.g., 'Custom ML Models', 'MLOps Development'). Max 3-4 words.
svc-card.p: Description of service scope, deliverables, and business value. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

svc-explore.span: Header label for specialisation chips (e.g., 'Explore specialisations'). Max 3 words.

comparison.eyebrow: Micro-label for comparison section (e.g., 'The honest comparison'). Max 3 words.
comparison.h2: Heading comparing independent specialist vs agency in {{CITY}} (e.g., 'Independent ML Engineer vs an ML company in {{CITY}}'). Must include {{CITY}}.
comparison.lede: Summary paragraph framing when an independent specialist is better vs a large agency. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

thead: Column header names (e.g., 'Factor', 'Independent engineer (me)', 'Established local company', 'Overseas agency').

tbody.th: Comparison criteria factor (e.g., 'Cost', 'Access to the builder', 'Local availability').
td: Evaluation string for each option under this factor.

btn--primary.text: CTA button text for quote request (e.g., 'Get a fixed quote for your project'). Max 6 words.

ctx-grid.eyebrow: Micro-label for ecosystem section (e.g., 'Local context'). Max 2 words.
ctx-grid.h2: Heading describing local technology ecosystem (e.g., 'The {{CITY}} machine learning and technology ecosystem'). Must include {{CITY}}.

p: Paragraph detailing institutions, tech corridors, and business adoption in {{CITY}} and {{STATE}}. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

link-cta.text: CTA link text for local hiring (e.g., 'Hire an AI developer in {{CITY}}').

ctx-float.span: Badge subtitle (e.g., 'Overlapping hours across India', 'In person across {{CITY}}').

ctx-grid.widget-title: Caption for the local ecosystem widget/chart (e.g., {{CITY}} · ML ecosystem). Must include {{CITY}}.
